answer: Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 110 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the pearl schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 110 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
